elements.description:
Four 100%-stacked column charts (y-axis: Share of the population (%), 0% to 100%), each with columns for Poor Population ($3.2) and Population in 2010 and 2020.

Panel 'Region' (legend: Central Highlands, Mekong Delta, Midlands & Northern Mountains, Northern & Coastal Central, Red River Delta, Southeast). Printed values:
- 2010 Poor Population: Mekong Delta 16%, Midlands & Northern Mountains 31%, Northern & Coastal Central 25%. Other segments (Central Highlands, Red River Delta, Southeast) are unlabeled, approximately ~9, ~11, ~5.
- 2010 Population: Mekong Delta 19%, Northern & Coastal Central 23%, Red River Delta 24%, Southeast 15%. Unlabeled: Midlands & Northern Mountains ~14, Central Highlands ~4.
- 2020 Poor Population: Central Highlands 21%, Mekong Delta ~13, Midlands & Northern Mountains 42%, Northern & Coastal Central 20%. Unlabeled: Red River Delta ~2, Southeast ~1.
- 2020 Population: Central Highlands ~6, Mekong Delta 17%, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~13, Northern & Coastal Central 21%, Red River Delta 25%, Southeast 18%.
Pattern: the poor population is concentrated in the Midlands & Northern Mountains and Northern & Coastal Central, while the Southeast and Central Highlands hold a much smaller share of the poor than of the total population in 2010 and 2020.

Panel 'Household engagement in agriculture' (legend: Not engaged in family farming; Some engagement in family farming; Only engaged in family farming). Printed values:
- 2010 Poor Population: Only engaged 59%, Some engagement 22%, Not engaged 18%.
- 2010 Population: Only engaged 28%, Some engagement 27%, Not engaged 45%.
- 2020 Poor Population: Only engaged 66%, Some engagement 21%, Not engaged 13%.
- 2020 Population: Only engaged 16%, Some engagement 23%, Not engaged 62%.
Pattern: the poor are far more likely than the population to be solely engaged in family farming, and this share rises from 2010 to 2020 among the poor.

Panel 'Urban vs Rural' (legend: Urban, Rural). Printed values:
- 2010 Poor Population: Urban 8%, Rural 92%.
- 2010 Population: Urban 30%, Rural 70%.
- 2020 Poor Population: Urban 11%, Rural 89%.
- 2020 Population: Urban 36%, Rural 64%.
Pattern: the poor are overwhelmingly rural, more so than the population as a whole.

Panel 'Ethnicity' (legend: Kinh majority, Ethnic minorities). Printed values:
- 2010 Poor Population: Kinh majority 47%, Ethnic minorities 53%.
- 2010 Population: Kinh majority 84%, Ethnic minorities 16%.
- 2020 Poor Population: Kinh majority 21%, Ethnic minorities 79%.
- 2020 Population: Kinh majority 85%, Ethnic minorities 15%.
Pattern: ethnic minorities make up a much larger share of the poor than of the population, and their share among the poor rises from 2010 to 2020.

Source note below the figure: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010, 2020.
